tasks.short: Investigate applications for special licenses or permits.

steps.what: Check applications for special licenses or permits for missing fields.
Investigate applications beyond the completeness list.
Visit the site when these permits require it.
Recommend grant, refusal, or a request for more.
Record the decision on the special licenses or permits.

tasks.design: The {WORKFLOW} checklist marks missing fields on an application and does not grant or refuse. The inspector reads what the list cannot score, visits when the permit type requires it, and recommends grant, refusal, or more information, which the licensing officer records. Native forms in the {WORKFLOW} are tested before custom code.
tasks.previous_blocker: Completeness and the decision were the same reading of a long form, so a missing field and a refusal looked alike.
tasks.enabler_now: A missing field can be listed. The reading, the visit and the recommendation cannot be the checklist.
tasks.still_hard: Permit types whose rules are not written as fields, and sites the inspector cannot enter.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector judges the application, and the licensing officer is the one who records the decision.

ambition.what: The inspector decides, before any visit, whether the application is complete enough to read.

tasks.altitude: Application reading stays on the week. A checklist cannot grant or refuse.

reach.task: Read an application a checklist has already scored
reach.learn: Which checklist result they still refuse to treat as a decision

evidence.claim: A form can list required fields that are empty. It cannot decide that a license or permit is granted or refused.

A decision that grants or refuses a permit has a significant effect. Solely automated decisions of that kind need a legal basis and a person who can intervene. The checklist here does not make that decision.

assumptions: Focal role is the property inspector. Boundary: from a received application to a recommendation. The officer records the decision.

Structured fields are application id, permit type and the required-field list. The applicant produces the application. The inspector produces the reading note and the recommendation. Fallback: a permit type with no field list is read in full by the inspector.
Test native application forms in {WORKFLOW} before custom code. The US task is read as a European public authority. This task does not monitor staff.
Upkeep of 2 hours per 100 baseline hours covers required fields by permit type.
unknowns: Which permit types legally require a visit.
Who is allowed to record the decision.
research_questions: What share of applications is complete on the field list and still needs a visit?

incremental.description: Keep required fields current for each permit type

approvals.approved_version: decision record the licensing officer made on this recommendation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the permit type has no field list and needs a visit, so the checklist saves nothing. High: missing fields are listed and the inspector still reads, visits when required, and recommends. The recommendation is not the checklist.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend legal or administrative action to protect government property.

steps.what: Choose the legal or administrative action to protect property.
Draft the text that will recommend the action.

loop.input: The finding brief and the action the inspector chose
loop.output: A recommendation that names that action and those findings
loop.check: Counsel and the inspector reject text that adds an action or a finding
loop.stop: One draft; if no action was chosen, nothing is drafted
loop.why_not_simpler: The letter has to follow this action, not a generic warning

steps.what: Review the recommendation before it is sent.
Send the recommendation to protect government property.

tasks.design: The inspector reads the findings and chooses the legal or administrative action. A draft may name only that action and those findings. Counsel accepts one version, and only that version is sent. Native action lists in {DOCS} are tested before custom code.
tasks.previous_blocker: The action and the letter were written together, so a template could recommend an action the findings did not support.
tasks.enabler_now: Drafting from a chosen action can change. Choosing the action, and counsel's review, stay.
tasks.still_hard: Findings that point to more than one action, and actions the authority is not allowed to take.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector chooses the action. Counsel knows whether that action can be sent.

ambition.what: The inspector names the action before any letter is drafted, on each case rather than only on the difficult ones.

tasks.altitude: Choosing the action stays on the week. The inspector can refuse a draft that adds an action.

reach.task: Recommend an action from a finding
reach.learn: How they name the action before they draft the letter

evidence.claim: A draft can be limited to an action a person has already chosen and to findings already accepted. It cannot choose the action.
A recommendation of legal or administrative action is an external act once it is sent. Counsel accepts the version first.

assumptions: Focal role is the property inspector. Boundary: from accepted findings to a sent recommendation. The inspection that produced the findings is another task.
Structured fields are finding id and action code. The inspector produces both. Fallback: an action that is not on the list is written by the inspector and is not drafted.
Test a native action list in {DOCS} before custom code. The US task is read as a European public authority. This task does not monitor staff.
Upkeep of 3 hours per 100 baseline hours covers the action list.
unknowns: Which actions counsel must see before they are sent.
The exact national power to take each action.
research_questions: What share of cases has more than one action that the findings could support?

incremental.description: Keep the list of actions the authority may take current

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the findings support more than one action, so the inspector writes the recommendation without a draft. High: the action is already chosen and the letter drafts from it, while counsel still accepts the version. The choice of action is not removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Testify in court or at proceedings on investigation findings.

steps.what: Gather investigation findings for the hearing.
Draft an outline of those investigation findings.

loop.input: The hearing bundle of accepted findings
loop.output: An outline that lists only those findings
loop.check: The inspector removes any point that is not in the bundle
loop.stop: One outline; questions from the hearing are not predicted
loop.why_not_simpler: The outline has to follow this case's findings, not a standard speech

steps.what: Testify in court or at administrative proceedings.
Note findings concerning what the court heard.

tasks.design: The hearing bundle is the accepted findings in {DOCS}. An outline may list only those findings. The inspector testifies in person and notes what the court heard. Native bundles in {DOCS} are tested before custom code.
tasks.previous_blocker: The bundle was assembled the night before, and the outline was a fresh document each time.
tasks.enabler_now: The outline can follow the findings. Testimony, and answers to questions, stay with the inspector in the room.
tasks.still_hard: Hearings that go beyond the findings, and questions the outline did not expect.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector is the person who was there, and is the one who can say what they found.
tasks.altitude: Hearings stay on the week. Nothing speaks for the inspector.

reach.task: Testify about findings at a proceeding
reach.learn: What they take into the room and what they leave in the file

evidence.claim: An outline can be limited to findings a person has already accepted. It cannot give the testimony.

assumptions: Focal role is the property inspector. Boundary: from accepted findings to testimony at one hearing. The investigation is another task.
Structured fields are case id, finding id and hearing date. The inspector produces the findings. Fallback: a finding that is not in the bundle is not put on the outline.
Test native bundles in {DOCS} before custom code. The US task is read as a European public authority. This task does not monitor staff.
Upkeep of 2 hours per 100 baseline hours covers the bundle fields.
unknowns: How often testimony is in court rather than an administrative proceeding.
Whether counsel reviews the outline today.
research_questions: What share of hearing time is answers to questions that were not in the outline?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the hearing is mostly unexpected questions, so the outline saves little. High: the bundle is already accepted and the outline lists it, while testimony stays in the room. The testimony is not removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Coordinate with law enforcement on matters of mutual concern.

steps.what: Coordinate matters of mutual concern with the agencies.
Decide how to assist without extra disclosure.
Draft the disclosure from accepted facts.

loop.output: A disclosure that contains only those facts
loop.check: Any fact not marked shareable is deleted
loop.stop: One draft; if nothing was marked shareable, nothing is drafted
loop.why_not_simpler: The disclosure has to follow this case's marked facts, not a standing pack

steps.what: Check the disclosure before it leaves.
Send the disclosure to law enforcement agencies.

tasks.design: The conversation with the agency stays with the inspector, who decides what may be shared. A disclosure may contain only facts marked shareable. The supervisor accepts that version before it is sent to the agency. Native disclosure fields in {DOCS} are tested before custom code.
tasks.previous_blocker: What was said on the call and what was later sent were not the same list, so a fact could leave without a decision.
tasks.enabler_now: The call and the decision stay. Only a fact already marked shareable can be put in the disclosure.
tasks.still_hard: Matters where the agency asks for something the inspector has not marked, and urgent calls with no file.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector knows the case and decides what the other agency may see.
tasks.altitude: Calls with agencies stay on the week. The inspector can stop a disclosure that adds a fact.

reach.task: Decide what to pass to another agency
reach.learn: Which fact they will not pass on without a recorded decision

evidence.claim: A disclosure can be limited to facts a person has marked as shareable. It cannot decide what another agency may see.
Passing case facts to another authority is an external act. A person accepts the version before it is sent.

assumptions: Focal role is the property inspector. Boundary: one matter of mutual concern, from the conversation to a sent disclosure. The investigation itself is another task.
Structured fields are case id, fact id and shareable flag. The inspector produces the flag. Fallback: a fact with no flag is omitted, not guessed.
Test native disclosure fields in {DOCS} before custom code. The US task is read as a European public authority. This task does not monitor staff.
Upkeep of 2 hours per 100 baseline hours covers the shareable-fact fields.
unknowns: Which facts may legally be passed to which agency.
Whether a data-protection assessment is required for this disclosure.
research_questions: What share of requests asks for a fact the inspector has not marked shareable?

approvals.approved_version: disclosure version the supervisor marked accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the matter is a live call with no marked facts, so nothing is drafted or sent. High: marked facts draft into a disclosure the supervisor still accepts. The call and the decision are not removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week is still sites, products, hearings and files. The inspector can stop a report, a disclosure or a sample submission that is not tied to a note they accepted.
reach: Environmental compliance inspectors: which site measurement they will not take from a photograph
Regulatory affairs specialists: which missing field stops a file
Claims adjusters, examiners, and investigators: how a finding stays tied to a note
skills_to_grow: Refusing a draft sentence that has no source note
Reading a checklist without treating it as a permit decision
Keeping a disclosure inside facts already accepted
role.ambitious_version: Every finding the inspector signs can be traced to a note they accepted, and no permit is granted by a checklist.
